boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bradley University
boards.description: Discover the essential late-night food stops and campus rituals that fuel Bradley University students during late study sessions and weekend gatherings in Peoria.

cards.title: Jumbo Slices at SliceHub
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Pizza on Bradley Avenue
cards.notes: Grab a massive 30-inch jumbo slice at this corner spot. It is a primary destination for students seeking hot food until 3:00 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: A local pizzeria known for oversized slices and late-night availability near the campus edge.
cards.evidence_claim: SliceHub Pizzeria is open for pickup and delivery until 3:00 AM every day of the week.
cards.source_title: SliceHub - Food Ordering
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM daily for walk-in pickup and delivery.

cards.title: Midnight Burritos at Moe's
cards.subtitle: Tex-Mex in the Michel Student Center
cards.notes: Visit the Student Center for burritos and free chips. This campus staple serves students until midnight most nights during the semester.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Tex-Mex restaurant located within the Michel Student Center offering late-night dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Moe's Southwest Grill at Bradley University is open until 12:00 AM Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Moe's Southwest Grill Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Michel Student Center; open until midnight daily.

cards.title: After-Hours at Williams
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Coffee and Study Space
cards.notes: Utilize the newly renovated dining hall's after-hours coffee shop for late-night caffeine and quiet study sessions on campus.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall featuring a dedicated after-hours coffee shop and expanded study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated Williams Dining Hall includes an after-hours coffee shop and additional study spaces for students.
cards.source_title: What's new at BU - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students with meal plans or campus IDs; features late-night coffee service.

cards.title: Evening Coffee at One World
cards.subtitle: Eclectic Dining on Main Street
cards.notes: Enjoy globally inspired flavors in an artistic setting. It is a long-standing student favorite for evening meals and coffee near campus.
cards.short_summary: A popular local cafe near Bradley University known for its diverse menu and artistic atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: One World Cafe is open until 8:00 PM Monday through Saturday, serving a full menu and coffee all day.
cards.source_title: One World - Peoria
cards.access_notes: Located at the corner of Main and University; open until 8:00 PM most nights.

cards.title: Freaky Fast Subs on Main
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Sandwiches Near Campus
cards.notes: Order a sub for a quick late-night meal. This location serves the Bradley community with late-night delivery and pickup options.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich shop located on Main Street providing quick meals and late-night delivery for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jimmy John's at 1121 W Main St is open until 10:00 PM daily for late-night meals.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Peoria | Jimmy John's 3289
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM daily for in-store pickup and delivery.

cards.title: Late Night BU Activities
cards.subtitle: Alcohol-Free Friday Night Fun
cards.notes: Attend these university-hosted events for free food from local vendors, games, and activities in the Markin Center on select Fridays.
cards.short_summary: A signature university program providing alcohol-free entertainment and food for students late on Friday nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night BU is a signature event that includes food from local restaurants and activities for students on campus.
cards.source_title: Signature Events - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Events typically held on Friday nights in the Markin Center; check campus calendar for dates.

cards.title: Midnight Study at Cullom-Davis
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Resources and Snacks
cards.notes: Study until midnight in the campus library. Vending machines provide quick snacks for students during intensive late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary university library offering late-night study hours and vending options for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Cullom-Davis Library is open until 12:00 AM Sunday through Thursday for student study sessions.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spaces On and Around Bradley - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM Sunday-Thursday; requires student ID for late entry.

cards.title: Philly Steaks at Campustown
cards.subtitle: Quick Bites in Campustown Center
cards.notes: Stop by for a signature Philly steak or gyro. This Campustown eatery is a convenient stop for students until 8:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: A local sandwich shop in the Campustown Shopping Center known for its steaks, fries, and gyros.
cards.evidence_claim: Steak & Fries in Campustown is open Monday through Saturday from 11:00 AM to 8:30 PM.
cards.source_title: Steak & Fries
cards.access_notes: Located in the Campustown Shopping Center; open until 8:30 PM Monday-Saturday.

cards.title: Evening Pho at Thanh Linh
cards.subtitle: Authentic Vietnamese on Main Street
cards.notes: Warm up with a bowl of noodle soup or bubble tea. This restaurant is a staple for students seeking authentic Vietnamese flavors in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned Vietnamese restaurant near campus offering traditional dishes and bubble tea.
cards.evidence_claim: Thanh Linh Vietnamese Restaurant is open until 8:30 PM Monday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Thanh Linh Vietnamese Restaurant
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:30 PM daily except Sundays.

cards.title: Late Snacks at the Marketplace
cards.subtitle: Convenience in the Student Center
cards.notes: Pick up grab-and-go snacks or deli items late into the night. It serves as a primary on-campus convenience option for residential students.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus deli and market providing convenient food options until midnight for the Bradley community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marketplace Deli in the Michel Student Center is open until 12:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: New time to eat: Dining services changes operating hours - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Michel Student Center; open until midnight daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific study nooks, collaborative lounges, and quiet corners that Bradley University students use to navigate daily life on the Hilltop.

cards.title: The Library Basement Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library
cards.notes: Head to the lowest level for absolute silence; this floor is strictly a no-talking zone preferred by students for intense finals prep.
cards.short_summary: The designated silent study floor of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library basement is a designated no-talking zone for students who need complete silence to focus.
cards.source_title: The Best Study Spaces at Bradley - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Sunday through Thursday during the academic semester.

cards.title: The Westlake Atrium Steps
cards.subtitle: Westlake Hall
cards.notes: Sit on the wide wooden tiers equipped with pillows and cushions for a relaxed, multi-level study environment with natural light.
cards.short_summary: Tiered seating area in the Westlake Hall atrium designed for casual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Westlake Hall features iconic study steps with pillows that serve as a comfortable and popular student study space.
cards.source_title: The Five Best Study Spots at Bradley University - Lydia's Lounge
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically quieter in the late afternoon.

cards.title: Convergence Center Glass Rooms
cards.subtitle: Business and Engineering Convergence Center
cards.notes: Book these high-tech glass-walled rooms for group projects; they feature large monitors and dry-erase surfaces for collaboration.
cards.short_summary: Modern, tech-equipped group study rooms in the BECC building.
cards.evidence_claim: The BECC offers large, secluded study rooms for groups that include TVs and screens for sharing work.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spaces On and Around Bradley - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Rooms are highly sought after; students often arrive early to secure a spot during peak times.

cards.title: Constance Hall Music Nooks
cards.subtitle: Constance Hall
cards.notes: Use the second and third-floor practice rooms for solo study or music practice; they are open to all students, not just music majors.
cards.short_summary: Individual practice and study rooms located in the music building.
cards.evidence_claim: Practice rooms on the second and third floors of Constance Hall are available to anyone when the building is open.
cards.source_title: General Audition Information / Fall 2025 - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Available during standard music building operational hours.

cards.title: The Alumni Center Museum
cards.subtitle: Hayden-Clark Alumni Center
cards.notes: Explore 22 interactive display cases and dioramas that chronicle Bradley's history in this quiet, air-conditioned gallery space.
cards.short_summary: A historical gallery and exhibit space within the Alumni Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shaheen Hall of Pride features 22 display cases and videos chronicling the university's history and is open to students.
cards.source_title: The Hayden-Clark Alumni Center | PeoriaMagazines.com
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor; accessible during Alumni Center business hours.

cards.title: The Markin Center Fuel Station
cards.subtitle: Markin Family Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Grab a smoothie and use the nearby seating for a post-workout study session or a quick breakfast between morning classes.
cards.short_summary: A juice bar and social seating area inside the campus recreation center.
cards.evidence_claim: Jerry's Juice Bar is located in the Markin Center and offers smoothies and bagels, serving as a favorite student stop.
cards.source_title: Tour: Markin Family Student Recreation Center
cards.access_notes: Accessible to anyone with Markin Center entry; check seasonal hours for the juice bar.

cards.title: The Centralized Mail Hub
cards.subtitle: Heitz Hall
cards.notes: Pick up your packages at these 24/7 smart lockers; it's the primary hub for all student mail on campus.
cards.short_summary: The university's centralized package and mail locker system.
cards.evidence_claim: Bradley's centralized mail center in Heitz Hall features secure smart lockers for student package pickup.
cards.source_title: Heitz Hall - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Locker access is available 24/7 for students with a valid BU ID.

cards.title: The Student Center Quiet Nook
cards.subtitle: Robert Michel Student Center
cards.notes: Avoid the noisy food court by heading to the upper level lobbies near the ballrooms for softer seating and a calmer atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: Quiet lounge areas located on the upper floors of the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: While the main floor is noisy, the Student Center offers various levels and areas that students use for gathering and work.
cards.source_title: The Five Best Study Spots at Bradley University - Lydia's Lounge
cards.access_notes: Open late during the week; check for event closures in the ballroom areas.

cards.title: The Science Building Tables
cards.subtitle: Olin Hall
cards.notes: Use the tables in the Olin Hall lobby for quick study sessions between labs; it's a convenient spot for STEM students.
cards.short_summary: Lobby seating area in the main science building.
cards.evidence_claim: Olin Hall is a primary academic building with lobby spaces used by students for studying between classes.
cards.source_title: Campus Map - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Best for short-term use during building hours.

cards.title: The U-Hall Social Hub
cards.subtitle: University Hall
cards.notes: Visit this iconic lounge in University Hall for student-led events and a central social space for first-year residents.
cards.short_summary: A well-known student lounge and event space in University Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: University Hall holds the iconic Lydia's Lounge, a central social and event space for students.
cards.source_title: Best Bradley University Dorm Ranked - Lydia's Lounge
cards.access_notes: Primarily used by residents of University Hall but hosts campus-wide student media events.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social activities and public spaces at Bradley University, from campus art galleries and historic halls to recreational facilities and community partnerships.

cards.title: Shoot Hoops at Markin
cards.subtitle: Indoor recreation and fitness
cards.notes: Access the basketball courts, indoor track, and climbing wall for free with your Bradley ID. It is a central hub for student fitness and intramural sports.
cards.short_summary: A 130,000-square-foot recreation facility featuring courts, a pool, and a 46-foot climbing wall.
cards.evidence_claim: Entrance to the general building, including the cardio area, will be free for students with Bradley IDs.
cards.source_title: Markin Center debuts - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; summer hours are typically 9 a.m. – 7 p.m. weekdays.

cards.title: Browse Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Heuser Art Center
cards.notes: Visit the main campus gallery to see rotating exhibitions of contemporary graphic media and student work. Admission is always free for the public.
cards.short_summary: A formal exhibition space in the Heuser Art Center hosting contemporary art and the Bradley International Print and Drawing Exhibition.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is always free and open to the public for the Gallery Program at Bradley University.
cards.source_title: Art & Design Department - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

cards.title: Explore Bradley History
cards.subtitle: Hayden-Clark Alumni Center
cards.notes: Walk through 22 display cases and interactive dioramas that chronicle the university's growth. See miniature models of historic dorm rooms at no cost.
cards.short_summary: A museum-style space on the first floor of the Alumni Center dedicated to Bradley's history and artifacts.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors can explore the university's past through displays and interactive presentations in the first-floor Shaheen Hall of Pride.
cards.source_title: Alumni Resources - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Hayden-Clark Alumni Center; generally open during university business hours.

cards.title: Visit the Riverfront Museum
cards.subtitle: Free student membership
cards.notes: Use your Bradley ID to get a complimentary membership. This grants you free admission to all galleries and planetarium shows at this major cultural center.
cards.short_summary: A partnership providing all Bradley students, faculty, and staff with free admission to Peoria's premier museum.
cards.evidence_claim: All Bradley students, faculty, and staff are now eligible for complimentary memberships to the museum, unlocking access to its full range of exhibitions.
cards.source_title: Bradley Partners with Peoria Riverfront Museum
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid Bradley University ID to activate the complimentary membership.

cards.title: Attend a Student Recital
cards.subtitle: Free musical performances
cards.notes: Catch a variety of free concerts and senior recitals throughout the semester. Most student-run performances are open to the public without a ticket.
cards.short_summary: The primary venue for Bradley's Department of Music, hosting numerous free student and faculty performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is free and open to the public for many student recitals and practicum concerts at Dingeldine Music Center.
cards.source_title: Upcoming Music Events at Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Check the university music calendar for specific free event dates and times.

cards.title: Study in the Stacks
cards.subtitle: Quiet campus study space
cards.notes: Find a quiet corner to study or browse the collections. Visitors are welcome until 9:00 p.m., while students have extended access with their ID.
cards.short_summary: The main university library offering multiple floors of study space, computer labs, and academic resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors are welcome in the Library until 9:00 p.m. or closing time on days we close earlier.
cards.source_title: Library Policies - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Public access until 9 p.m.; Bradley ID required for entry after 9 p.m. and for study room reservations.

cards.title: View Theatre District Art
cards.subtitle: Hartmann Center for the Performing Arts
cards.notes: Explore the second of Bradley's formal exhibition spaces located in the theatre building. It features rotating shows that are free to the public.
cards.short_summary: An art gallery located within the Hartmann Center that stimulates discourse through contemporary art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is always free and open to the public for the Hartmann Center Gallery.
cards.source_title: About – Bradley University Galleries
cards.access_notes: Open during regular building hours, typically Monday through Friday.

cards.title: Visit the Athletics Museum
cards.subtitle: Renaissance Coliseum
cards.notes: Located inside the Coliseum, this hall of fame showcases Bradley's athletic history and trophies. It is free to visit during regular building hours.
cards.short_summary: An athletics museum and hall of fame located within the Renaissance Coliseum facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Hours of Operation Monday – Friday: 8 a.m. – 5 p.m. Includes Burklund Family Heritage Hall.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.; weekend access is contingent on events.

cards.title: Hike the Bluff Trails
cards.subtitle: Adjacent city park
cards.notes: Walk the 140 acres of trails and scenic bluffs right next to campus. The park features a Japanese bridge and disc golf course available for free use.
cards.short_summary: A large public park adjacent to the university offering hiking, disc golf, and picnic areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Bradley Park is a 140-acre park featuring trails, a disc golf course, and a Japanese bridge, open sunrise to sunset.
cards.source_title: Bradley Park - Peoria Park District
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset.

cards.title: Relax in the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Campus social hub
cards.notes: Hang out in the various lounges or visit the Kaleidoscope Center to play games and connect with peers. It is the primary spot for casual student gatherings.
cards.short_summary: The central student union building featuring lounges, meeting rooms, and student organization offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors are welcome to study, play games, and relax in the Michel Student Center spaces like the Kaleidoscope Center.
cards.source_title: Office of Campus Culture & Climate - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; specific center hours within the building may vary (e.g., 10 a.m. – 4 p.m. for some offices).

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.title: Silent Study Floor
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library
cards.notes: Utilize the basement level for absolute silence. It houses the general book collection and offers individual study rooms that can be reserved for up to four hours.
cards.short_summary: The designated quietest floor of the main campus library, featuring individual carrels and reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The basement is the quiet/silent study level and contains study rooms, soft seating, and the general book collection.
cards.source_title: What is located on each floor of the library? - FAQ
cards.access_notes: Open to students with a valid Bradley ID; hours typically 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM Sunday-Thursday.

cards.title: BECC Collaborative Rooms
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Bradley Avenue
cards.notes: Reserve a private glass-walled room for group projects. These spaces feature large monitors for screen sharing and ample natural light from the building's atrium.
cards.short_summary: Modern, tech-equipped private rooms within the university's newest academic facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The BECC offers private study rooms with high comfort and low noise levels, plus tech for collaborative work.
cards.source_title: The Five Best Study Spots at Bradley University - Lydia's Lounge
cards.access_notes: Accessible to all students; rooms are highly sought after during finals week.

cards.title: The Study Steps
cards.subtitle: Olin Quad
cards.notes: Sit on the wide wooden staircase equipped with colorful pillows and cushions. It provides a tiered, informal environment for reading between classes.
cards.short_summary: An iconic tiered seating area in the renovated Westlake Hall, popular for its relaxed atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Westlake's study steps allow for an unusual but comfortable study space with pillows and cushions.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spaces On and Around Bradley - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; generally quieter in the late afternoon.

cards.title: The Atrium
cards.subtitle: 915 N Elmwood Ave
cards.notes: Work at the tables near the large floor-to-ceiling windows. This spot offers high visibility and easy access to food options on the main level.
cards.short_summary: A bright, high-traffic study area on the main level of the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The atrium is a popular location on the main level of the Student Center with large windows and natural light.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spaces On and Around Bradley - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open late; food options available until 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Low-Stress Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library 1st Floor
cards.notes: Visit this space for a mental break or low-intensity studying. It is designed to be a safe, welcoming environment for students to decompress.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated wellness-focused space within the library for relaxation and quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Breathing Room is located on the main floor of the library as a space for students to relax and connect.
cards.source_title: Cullom-Davis Library - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during regular library hours; no reservation required.

cards.title: The Veranda
cards.subtitle: 816 N Tobias Ln
cards.notes: Study outdoors on the third-floor veranda overlooking the quad. This spot offers one of the best elevated views of the campus landscape.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor balcony space providing a quiet, scenic environment for fair-weather studying.
cards.evidence_claim: A banquet room on the third floor accesses a veranda with views of the quad.
cards.source_title: Hayden-Clark Alumni Center - Dewberry
cards.access_notes: Access may be limited during private alumni events; check building schedule.

cards.title: Jerry's Juice Bar Lounge
cards.subtitle: 819 N Haussler Ln
cards.notes: Grab a smoothie and use the lounge seating for a post-workout study session. It's a high-energy spot with frequent student traffic.
cards.short_summary: A casual lounge area within the recreation center, ideal for quick tasks between gym sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Jerry's juice bar is located in the facility and offers snack options, making it a favorite stop when heading to class.
cards.source_title: Tour: Markin Family Student Recreation Center
cards.access_notes: Open during Markin Center hours; requires Bradley ID for entry.

cards.title: Individual Quiet Pods
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library 1st Floor
cards.notes: Claim one of the semi-enclosed pods for focused individual work. These provide a visual barrier from the main floor's activity.
cards.short_summary: Semi-private individual seating units designed for distraction-free studying on the main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The main floor of the library features quiet pods and soft seating.
cards.source_title: What is located on each floor of the library? - FAQ
cards.access_notes: Available on a first-come, first-served basis during library hours.

cards.title: Inclusive Study Space
cards.subtitle: Michel Student Center Room 11
cards.notes: Study in a welcoming environment that offers comfy seats and office materials. It's a hub for community and advocacy that also supports quiet work.
cards.short_summary: A safe-space lounge in the student center that welcomes students for both social connection and studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors are welcome to study, play games, and relax in the Kaleidoscope Center.
cards.source_title: Office of Campus Culture & Climate - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday with specific afternoon hours; check website for current schedule.

cards.title: The Music Library
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Study surrounded by thousands of music scores and recordings. This specialized collection area offers a unique, academic atmosphere on the library's second floor.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library branch within the main library, recently relocated to the second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: In 2025, the Music Resource Center was moved into a new dedicated space on the second floor of the library.
cards.source_title: Music Resource Center - Bradley University Music History
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; features listening facilities and computer areas.

cards.title: Laura Bradley Park

cards.notes: Search for gently used titles at this independent bookstore, a staple of the West Main arts and small business district.

cards.evidence_claim: Lit. On Fire is a used bookstore located in the West Main neighborhood hub of arts and culture.

cards.title: Metro Centre

cards.evidence_claim: Metro Centre is located at 4700 N. University St. and hosts the Peoria Farmers Market.

cards.access_notes: Public shopping center; Farmers Market typically runs May through October.

cards.evidence_claim: Moon Dancer is described as a shop for funky clothing and accessories in Peoria's West Main neighborhood.

cards.access_notes: Standard retail hours; open to the public.

cards.notes: Stroll down this historic tree-lined street to view classic brick homes and architecture in the neighborhood south of campus.

cards.evidence_claim: Moss Avenue is a central feature of the Moss-Bradley neighborhood, known for its tree-lined streets and historic homes.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing traditions that define the Bradley University experience on the Hilltop.

cards.title: Lighting of the B
cards.subtitle: A Homecoming Beacon Since 1928
cards.notes: Gather at Bradley Hall during Homecoming to watch the iconic red 'B' illuminate the night sky, a tradition signaling the start of festivities for nearly a century.
cards.short_summary: A historic Homecoming ritual where a large neon 'B' atop Bradley Hall is lit to welcome alumni and students.
cards.evidence_claim: The ceremonial lighting of the Bradley “B” is a homecoming tradition that began in 1928 on top of Bradley Hall.
cards.source_title: The Lighting of the B Tradition - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Free public event held annually during Homecoming week in front of Bradley Hall.

cards.title: Honoring the Foundress
cards.subtitle: Founder's Circle Landmark
cards.notes: Visit the statue of Lydia Moss Bradley in Founder's Circle, where students often leave flowers or take photos to celebrate the university's philanthropic roots.
cards.short_summary: A central campus statue dedicated to the university's founder, serving as a focal point for campus pride and ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: The statue of Lydia Moss Bradley sits in the middle of Founder's Circle and was unveiled in 1997 for the 100th anniversary.
cards.source_title: History of the Hilltop: outdoor art - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 in the outdoor Founder's Circle area.

cards.title: Late Night BU
cards.subtitle: Alcohol-Free Friday Fun
cards.notes: Head to the Markin Center for themed late-night events featuring free food, inflatables, and unique activities like petting zoos or laser tag.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night event series providing students with safe, alcohol-free entertainment on Friday nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night BU is an event hosted by Student Engagement that serves as an alternative to alcohol for students on Bradley's campus.
cards.source_title: Signature Events - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Typically held on select Friday nights from 9:00 PM to midnight at the Markin Center.

cards.title: Founder's Day Convocation
cards.subtitle: Celebrating Lydia's Legacy
cards.notes: Attend the annual October ceremony at Dingeldine Music Center to honor faculty and alumni who embody the spirit of Lydia Moss Bradley.
cards.short_summary: An annual formal gathering that commemorates the vision and leadership of the university's founder.
cards.evidence_claim: The annual Founder's Day Convocation commemorates the vision of Mrs. Bradley and recognizes faculty, staff, and alumni.
cards.source_title: Founder's Day - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in October at the Dingeldine Music Center; open to the campus community.

cards.title: Ringing the Victory Bell
cards.subtitle: A Post-Game Celebration
cards.notes: Listen for the clanging of the Victory Bell near the athletic facilities, a sound that has signaled Bradley athletic triumphs for decades.
cards.short_summary: A traditional bell rung to celebrate Bradley Braves athletic victories and foster campus spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Victory Bell is a fixture that signals victory for the university's athletic teams, a tradition rooted in campus history.
cards.source_title: 125 years of Bradley remembered - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Located near the Renaissance Coliseum; rung following home victories.

cards.title: Kaboom! the Gargoyle
cards.subtitle: The Hilltop's Unique Mascot
cards.notes: Look for Kaboom! at sporting events; this gargoyle mascot was inspired by the architectural features of Bradley Hall.
cards.short_summary: The official mascot of Bradley University, a gargoyle that represents the school's unique architectural heritage.
cards.evidence_claim: Kaboom! the gargoyle was adopted in 2014 as the university's mascot, inspired by the gargoyles on Bradley Hall.
cards.source_title: History of the Hilltop: Mascots - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Appears at Renaissance Coliseum and Carver Arena during athletic events.

cards.title: Taste of Bradley
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week Food Truck Fest
cards.notes: Enjoy local Peoria flavors at Olin Quad during Welcome Week, where food trucks gather to feed the incoming class.
cards.short_summary: An annual Welcome Week event featuring local food trucks and community dining on the campus quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Taste of Bradley is an annual event where local food trucks park in the quad and offer their specialties during Welcome Week.
cards.source_title: Signature Events - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in August on Olin Quad; open to students and staff.

cards.title: The Human 'B' Photo
cards.subtitle: A Freshman Rite of Passage
cards.notes: Join your classmates on the quad during Welcome Week to form a massive human 'B' for the traditional class photo.
cards.short_summary: A tradition where the incoming freshman class forms a giant letter 'B' on the quad for a commemorative photograph.
cards.evidence_claim: First-year convocation is followed by a class photo in the shape of a B as part of Welcome Week activities.
cards.source_title: Signature Events - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in August on the campus quad for the incoming first-year class.

cards.title: The Red Zone
cards.subtitle: Courtside Student Spirit
cards.notes: Experience the energy of Bradley Basketball from the Red Zone, the dedicated courtside student section at Carver Arena.
cards.short_summary: The official student section for Bradley Braves basketball, known for its high energy and courtside presence.
cards.evidence_claim: The Red Zone is a VIP Premium Courtside Club available exclusively for Bradley University students during men's basketball games.
cards.source_title: One-Of-A-Kind, VIP Student Section - Bradley University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Located at Carver Arena; requires a valid Bradley Student ID for entry.

cards.title: Hilltop Trot
cards.subtitle: Homecoming 5K Run
cards.notes: Race through the scenic Hilltop campus during Homecoming weekend in this annual 5K run and 1-mile walk event.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming tradition featuring a 5K run and 1-mile walk that traverses the Bradley University campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hilltop Trot is a 5K run or 1-mile walk through Bradley University's campus held during Homecoming.
cards.source_title: Homecoming Events Open to the Community - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Held annually on Saturday morning of Homecoming weekend; registration required.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Bradley University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Meet at the Lydia Moss Bradley Statue
cards.subtitle: Founder's Circle at Bradley Hall
cards.notes: Start your weekend at the bronze statue of the university founder. It is a central campus landmark and a popular spot for first-year class photos.
cards.short_summary: A central campus landmark featuring the statue of university founder Lydia Moss Bradley.
cards.evidence_claim: The bronze Lydia Moss Bradley statue has graced the university's Founder's Circle since 1997 and is a site for orientation and class photos.
cards.source_title: Lydia is back - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a public outdoor space on campus.

cards.title: Lunch at the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Michel Student Center
cards.notes: Grab a meal at the Marketplace Deli or Chick-fil-A. This hub is the go-to for reliable dining options and meeting up with new hall mates.
cards.short_summary: The primary student hub for dining, featuring a food court and student organization offices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Michel Student Center is the place to go for reliable dining options like Marketplace Deli and Chick-fil-A, accessible via meal plans.
cards.source_title: Looking For A Bite To Eat On Campus? - Lydia's Lounge
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend hours typically 11 a.m. to midnight.

cards.title: Join the Welcome Bash
cards.subtitle: Alumni Quad
cards.notes: Head to the quad for the annual Welcome Bash. It is a prime opportunity to meet other students and engage with campus faculty in a relaxed setting.
cards.short_summary: A large outdoor green space that hosts major Welcome Week events and student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Welcome Bash is held on the Alumni Quad during Welcome Week to help students connect and build friendships.
cards.source_title: Signature Events - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor event; specific times vary by year but typically midday on Sunday.

cards.title: Explore the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Markin Center
cards.notes: Check out the 46-foot rock climbing wall or the indoor pool. It is the center for intramurals and late-night student activities.
cards.short_summary: A 130,000-square-foot facility featuring a climbing wall, pool, and basketball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Markin Center features a 46-foot rock climbing wall, indoor pool, and four basketball courts, and hosts Late Night BU events.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Weekend hours are typically 12 p.m. to 7 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library
cards.notes: Visit the library to scout out the quiet basement for solo study or the first floor for group work. You can also pick up your Bradley ID here.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering three floors of varied study environments and IT support.
cards.evidence_claim: Cullom-Davis Library offers three floors of seating and is the location for QuickCard (ID) pick-up during move-in weekend.
cards.source_title: Moving In - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Open 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. on move-in Saturday; regular late hours until midnight.

cards.title: Sample the Taste of Bradley
cards.subtitle: Olin Quad
cards.notes: Visit this annual event where local food trucks park in the quad. It is a great way to sample Peoria's local flavors without leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: An annual Welcome Week event featuring local food trucks on the Olin Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Taste of Bradley is an annual event where local food trucks park in the quad and offer specialties to students.
cards.source_title: Signature Events - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Typically held Sunday evening from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. during Welcome Week.

cards.title: Attend a Guest Speaker Session
cards.subtitle: Renaissance Coliseum
cards.notes: Visit this multi-use athletic facility for first-weekend guest speakers or to tour the athletics museum in Burklund Family Heritage Hall.
cards.short_summary: A 165,200-square-foot athletic venue and home to the university's athletics hall of fame.
cards.evidence_claim: Renaissance Coliseum hosts Welcome Week guest speakers and includes the Burklund Family Heritage Hall athletics museum.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled events; museum hours typically Monday-Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

cards.title: Explore Campus History
cards.subtitle: Shaheen Hall of Pride
cards.notes: Walk through the Shaheen Hall of Pride to see 22 display cases and dioramas chronicling Bradley's growth since 1897.
cards.short_summary: A Collegiate Gothic building featuring a museum-style hall dedicated to university history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shaheen Hall of Pride in the Hayden-Clark Alumni Center features 22 display cases and dioramas chronicling the university's history.
cards.source_title: The Hayden-Clark Alumni Center | PeoriaMagazines.com
cards.access_notes: Open 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. on move-in Saturday; regular hours vary.

cards.title: Visit the Historic Clock School
cards.subtitle: Westlake Hall Atrium
cards.notes: See the renovated interior of one of Bradley's original buildings. Once a school of horology, it now features a modern six-story atrium.
cards.short_summary: One of the university's two original buildings, now featuring a modern collaborative atrium.
cards.evidence_claim: Westlake Hall is one of the two original buildings on campus, originally home to the School of Horology, and was renovated to include a new center atrium.
cards.source_title: Tour: Westlake Hall
cards.access_notes: Academic building; accessible during standard university hours.

cards.title: Walk the Fredonia Block Party
cards.subtitle: Fredonia Avenue
cards.notes: Stroll down Fredonia Avenue during the Welcome Week block party to learn about student organizations and Greek life on campus.
cards.short_summary: A street adjacent to campus that hosts a major annual block party for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Block Party on Fredonia is a Welcome Week event where students can get an up-close look at Greek Life and student organizations.
cards.source_title: Signature Events - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Typically held Monday afternoon from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m. during Welcome Week.
